purpose: R&D for a continuous glucose monitoring sensor. Our engineers need realistic HbA1c levels in the target population to calibrate the performance targets.
question: What is the mean HbA1c of adults with type 2 diabetes in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient; patients without an HbA1c are left out.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes who have an HbA1c and their mean HbA1c, one decimal.
